messages:
ara: Quick async — onboarding two open models into the catalog: saffron-7b (community fine-tuned) and mistral-lite (opt-quant).
ara: TL;DR: saffron -> legal looks likely ok, perf baseline needed; owner @mira. mistral-lite -> license ambiguous, owner @david. Goal: canary next week.
sam: Can we get perf numbers at 2k tokens and a simple benchmark script? where should owners drop results?
mira: I'm owner for saffron. Running perf now on a small staging fleet, will post p50/p95 + throughput in the PR by EOD. CR for model-metadata is at https://git.internal/redwood/models/pull/123 — needs one more review.
david: I'll ping legal about mistral-lite. Quick heads-up: upstream doc has conflicting license lines (one says "non-commercial"). Also we need quant profiles — @chris can you validate 4-bit runtime? saw memory spike last week.
chris: infra update: staging deploys succeed for saffron but mistral-lite 4-bit path hits unsupported op on our kernel (repro'd). Filing bug #789. I'll try a kernel patch this afternoon, ETA ~6h.
nina: Confirming — saffron license is fine but requires attribution text in the catalog page. For mistral-lite we need an explicit clarification from the model authors about the "non-commercial" clause. I'll draft an email template to send.
mira: noted, will add attribution line to metadata. Perf quick numbers (1k tokens): p50 48ms, p95 210ms, throughput ~360 tok/s on g5-8x. I'll attach the full perf CSV to the PR.
ara: Nice — owners please update model-acceptance.yaml with: legal_status, perf_baseline_link, infra_blockers. If we get legal clarity on mistral by tomorrow, canary on Fri.
david: Adding myself to legal thread @nina. Current blockers: quant kernel, license clar.
catalog-bot: model-ingest CI: artifact build succeeded for saffron-7b, tag saffron-7b:v1.0 :white_check_mark:
mira: CR merged for saffron metadata, canary flow scheduled for staging tomorrow.
sam: Small docs ask — add a one-line attribution blurb in console/docs for open models. I'll open a docs PR and tag owners.
ara: Great. I'll run a quick triage tomorrow 10:00 PT to confirm blockers. Thanks everyone :pray:
